plugins.description: React/TypeScript frontend + Go backend enforcement harness. 98 wired hooks (108 scripts) enforce patterns on every edit. Green != done: `test-warning-check` + `ci-warning-audit` block passing tests with DeprecationWarning / React `act()` / unhandled rejection noise (local + `gh run view --log` on green CI). 85 skills from TDD through CI-green PR, including /aip protobuf API design, /prime startup briefs, /thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review release-blocking PR audits, /resilience-review resilience checks, /diagnosing-bugs feedback-loop-first 6-phase debugger + /triage multi-tracker (gh + acli) state machine + /steelman anti-sycophancy guard + /upgrade-dependency safe dependency upgrades + /snyk-ux-security JS+Go per-path vuln sweep (exploitability-triage first gate via `bun why`/`go mod why`/`govulncheck`; top-level direct dep bump first, parent dep second, resolutions/overrides/replace last resort only; React 18 pin + changelog-walked majors + no-deferral escalation; Go `go get -u` + `go mod tidy` + `govulncheck` verify). 21 LLM failure modes enforced (7 Karpathy single-agent + 14 MAST multi-agent, Cemri et al. NeurIPS 2025). OWASP + STRIDE + snyk/bun audit. Core Web Vitals perf gate. bun.lock + yarn.lock parity enforced. Worktree isolation + branch safety. MCP ban with CLI redirect (~20x savings). Agent-browser integration (~91% token reduction). 9 agents (3-hat plan review + karpathy reference), 5 routines. Opus 4.7 tuned. POSIX-friendly.

Vague-prose domain-glossary + ADR awareness added to `/tdd`, `/improve-codebase-architecture`, `/zoom-out`, `/triage` -- soft-dep, degrades gracefully when no `CONTEXT.md`. Upstream content merged while preserving 3-hat fan-out: `improve-codebase-architecture/LANGUAGE.md` (canonical vocab module/interface/seam/adapter/depth/leverage/locality + deletion test + interface-is-test-surface + one-vs-two-adapters); `tdd/tests.md` (good vs bad tests -- behaviour through public interface, never impl); `domain-model/ADR-FORMAT.md` 'what qualifies' enriched (boundary decisions, invisible constraints, non-obvious rejections). x-changelog.4.9.0: 2026-04-23 -- Green != done warnings gate (+2 hooks, 89->91 wired / 98->100 scripts). `test-warning-check.sh` (PostToolUse Bash) scans passing `vitest`/`bun test`/`playwright`/`tsgo`/`biome`/`lint` output for curated patterns: Node `DeprecationWarning` + `ExperimentalWarning` + `(node:...) XxxWarning`, React `act()`/missing-key/DOM-nesting/prop-type/bad-setstate/non-boolean-attr, unhandled rejection / unhandled error, vitest `stderr |` during test, skipped-test counts, `@ts-expect-error` / `@ts-ignore`, `npm WARN deprecated`. No per-file or env warning bypass. 3x same-kind streak escalates. `ci-warning-audit.sh` (Stop) fetches `gh run view --log` on green PR CI (per-SHA cache, 45s timeout), greps same pattern, blocks with file:line sample. Gates: feature branch, session touched code, PR exists, all checks SUCCESS. No CI warning env bypass. CLAUDE.md Tests section adds green-not-done rule. /tdd `When Done` checklist adds zero-warnings local + CI log audit. Why: tests can be green while runtime spews deprecations / logs errors / leaks unhandled rejections -- noise that rots into real bugs when the libs actually remove the API. Agent must now clean before calling it done.
